title: KYA-OS community registry entry
description: One entry in the KYA-OS community registry. Each entry lives at registry/builders/<slug>.json and the filename must equal the `slug` property. Structural validation is enforced by scripts/validate.mjs (including cross-file checks this schema cannot express, like `standards` slugs resolving to registry/interop/ files); keep that script and this schema in sync.

name.description: Display name of the project or team.

slug.description: URL-safe identifier. Must match the entry filename: registry/builders/<slug>.json. Unique across the whole registry (builders AND interop).

description.description: Short description of what this entry ships on KYA-OS (280 characters max).

kind.description: What kind of entry this is. Determines which site section renders it: implementation/service/integration/marketplace go to #builders, template to #templates, example to #examples.

buildsOn.description: Which KYA-OS repos this entry builds on.

standards.description: Interop-registry slugs this entry exercises. Every slug MUST exist as registry/interop/<slug>.json (cross-file check enforced by scripts/validate.mjs).

level.description: Compliance level claimed, per kya-os-mcp CONFORMANCE.md.

scope.description: Whether the claim covers every vector category at the level, or a named subset. A subset never renders as a bare level.

categories.description: Vector categories the claim covers (e.g. signed-proof). Required when scope is subset.

suiteVersion.description: The conformance suite version the claim ran against (semver).

status.description: Claim status. `verified` requires `attestationUrl` and renders green only with that credential link; anything else renders amber or grey.

attestationUrl.description: Canonical URL of the verification credential. Required when status is verified.

conformance.description: Conformance claim for this entry. Honesty rules: subset claims always name their categories; verified requires the credential link.

platform.description: Deploy target the URL launches on.

deploy.description: One-click deploy targets, rendered as deploy buttons on template entries.

contact.description: How maintainers can reach you about this entry.

listedAt.description: Date the entry was added, YYYY-MM-DD.
